articles.title: Real Time Tissue Characterisation Using Mass Spectrometry REI-EXCISE iKnife Study
articles.summary: REI-EXCISE is a multicentre, prospective, non-randomised feasibility study, aimed to evaluate the diagnostic accuracy of rapid ionisation mass spectroscopy using an iKnife device. The iKnife will collect vapour, a by-product of surgery, which will pass through the mass spectrometer machine for analysis in order to evaluate what is "normal" and what is "cancerous" breast tissue.
